name: io.github.pad01g/yacy-search
title: YaCy peer-to-peer search
description: Web search, crawling and ranking evaluation on your own YaCy peer: no API key, no central service.

environmentVariables.name: YACY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your YaCy peer as seen from the MCP server container, e.g. http://yacy:8090 on a shared Docker network (docker run --network ...), or http://host.docker.internal:8090

environmentVariables.name: YACY_ADMIN_USER
environmentVariables.description: YaCy administrator account, needed for crawling and settings

environmentVariables.name: YACY_ADMIN_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: YaCy administrator password; without it crawl, settings and the index counts of index_status are not available

environmentVariables.name: YACY_CRAWL_ALLOW_PRIVATE
environmentVariables.description: 1 lets crawl reach loopback and private addresses (intranets); off by default

environmentVariables.name: YACY_ALLOW_TRUST_SETTINGS
environmentVariables.description: 1 lets set_ranking_setting change the trust filter settings (acceptUnverified, excludeTags); off by default
